tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the products in your ReddTrends account with their keywords and reports, plus the credit the next full report would use.

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: Add your product so ReddTrends can find Reddit threads for it. Give the website URL; ReddTrends reads the homepage and suggests the name, description, buyer keywords (with Google search volume) and competitors. Pass any field to override the suggestion. Counts toward your plan’s product limit; sugge

tools.name: start_report
tools.description: Find the Reddit threads that rank on Google for the product’s buyer keywords, and judge each one: mention your product, answer without a link, or skip. kind "free_preview" is one free preview per account (3 threads shown). kind "paid" uses one report credit from your plan or a single-report purchase

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Status and results of a report: each Reddit thread with its Google rank, keywords, verdict (mention / answer / skip), what the asker wants, how to reply and the risk, plus the self-promotion rules of the subreddits involved. Threads beyond the free preview come back locked (title and subreddit only)

tools.name: get_subreddit_rules
tools.description: What a subreddit’s written rules say about self-promotion: whether links to your product are allowed, whether you may post about it, any account age or karma requirement, and one plain sentence summary. Results are cached for 7 days; checking a new subreddit is limited to 20 a day.

tools.name: get_subreddit_stats
tools.description: Members, active users and 7- and 30-day growth for a subreddit in the ReddTrends directory (333 well-known communities). Daily snapshots stopped in September 2026 (last on 2026-09-17); "asOf" gives the date each figure is from.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_product, get_report, get_subreddit_rules · Public sink: get_subreddit_rules.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_product, get_report, get_subreddit_rules · Public sink: get_subreddit_rules

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
